chunks: Hammad narrated from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام:
He was asked about walnuts that cannot be counted individually, so they are measured with a measure, then what is in it is counted, and then the remainder is measured according to that count.
He said: “There is no problem with that.”

key_terms.بِمِكْيَالٍ: with a measuring vessel or standard measure
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ: there is no problem with it; it is permissible

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to estimate the number of goods by measuring a sample and calculating the rest from it?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on estimating the number of walnuts by using a measured sample and then applying that count to the remaining quantity. Imam Abu Abdullah عليه السلام permits this method, indicating its acceptability in sale and counting practices when direct counting is difficult.
